sample_id.description: Unique local sample identifier; arbitrary renaming preserves identity.

sample_name.description: Native label of an identifiable target preparation/pool; never infer individuals.

biological_source.description: Source cells/tissues/organisms; distinguish cellular origin from matrix/reagent origin. Include supported source identifiers.

species.description: Species of assayed biological material; retain distinct origins in mixed-species preparations.

biological_model.description: Reported cell line, genotype/disease or experimental model.

sample_material.description: Actual assayed material, preparation history and physical pooling. State unresolved pool size/members; never reconstruct them.

sample_accession.description: Source-supported sample-level accessions in the format Database:Identifier (sample), for example GEO:GSM9564434 (sample); BioSample:SAMN56344589 (sample). Use canonical database capitalization, no spaces around the colon, one space before the parenthesis, and semicolon-space between entries. Preserve identifier versions and order. Project/study identifiers do not identify samples and are not allowed here. Use null when unreported.

sample_id.description: Submitted target sample receiving this condition.

condition_target.description: Receiving material/component; identify source-cell pretreatment when applicable to target preparation.

experimental_factor.description: One requested identifiable factor; retain dose with its anchored timing.

factor_value.description: A finite JSON number or a compact source-reported numeric expression such as <0.22, 2–4, 350–400, 1:2 or 5±1. Keep units in factor_unit. Do not put categories, explanatory words, units, NR/NE or null in factor_value. Create a condition row only when the requested numerical value is reported. Otherwise omit that condition row and describe the missing requested value in the corresponding sample.sample_material. Preserve genuine zeros and reported bounds; never substitute an invented midpoint. A reported factor_value remains valid when its factor_unit or time is null because that attribute is unreported or inapplicable.

factor_unit.description: Reported factor unit; null if inapplicable or unsupported.

time.description: Plain anchored time/interval; no nested time object.

assay_id.description: Unique actual acquisition/library or labelled aggregate identifier.

sample_ids.description: Submitted sample IDs actually associated with this assay; multiple IDs do not imply pooling.

assay_type.description: Biomedical assay technique for selected experiment.

method.description: Procedure, native library label and unresolved run/multiplex mapping. Do not infer physical runs.

experiment_run_accession.description: Prefer source-supported experiment/library/run accessions, formatted Database:Identifier (level/type), for example SRA:SRX32380739 (experiment) or SRA:SRR28740494 (run). If these are not reported, use an associated source-supported project/study accession or repository record with its actual level/type, for example PRIDE:PXD057572 (project), GEO:GSE311704 (study), Figshare:10.6084/m9.figshare.29955509.v3 (dataset), or Zenodo:10.5281/zenodo.17874586 (software). Use canonical database capitalization, no spaces around the colon, one space before the parenthesis, and semicolon-space between entries. Preserve identifier versions and order. Put content descriptions in Method or separate review records. A shared higher-level record does not identify an individual acquisition or establish pooling. Use null when unreported.

description: Complete basic JSON response: exactly the three root arrays sample, condition and assay_run. No outer tables wrapper or additional root keys. Each condition.factor_value is a source-supported finite number or compact numeric expression; never null. Omit a condition with an unreported requested numerical value and explain the absence in sample.sample_material.
